notes.main_comparison: composition test N representation, PROCESS - OUTCOME native utility
notes.primary_inference: per-seed family-paired bootstrap (2000, seed23); seed mean is descriptive

q1_main_process_minus_outcome_compositio.answer: NO DIFFERENCE: exactly 0.0 in both seeds; both PROCESS and OUTCOME converged to a constant UNKNOWN/query policy.

q2_process_vs_outcome_diagnostics.answer: No process advantage. Both arms: utility 9.0, success 1.0, queries 1.0, process_support 0.5, final_correct 0.50390625; wrong/tool/abort 0. F step accuracy 0/623, U 664/664, O 276/524, S 230/443 in both. This is constant Z (UNKNOWN) at every step.

q3_training_signal.answer: Group-relative RL had almost no learning signal. zero-advantage groups per update: PROCESS 3.77-3.92/4, OUTCOME 3.93-3.96/4; 112-125 of 128 updates had all four groups zero. The terminal optimum is query-only (utility 9), and T=1.0 categorical four-sample groups collapse there.

q4_process_sft.answer: Process labels are learnable. Zero-init SFT fits training labels (loss ~1e-7, action accuracy 1.0) and reaches test support 0.9967/0.9808 and final_correct 0.9805/0.9414, but composition utility is only 7.977/5.234, below QUERY_ONCE 9.0 and DEPENDENCY_RULE 9.496; rare wrong side effects (1.95%/5.86%) and U/reminder composition errors dominate. This is not evidence of a new PRM.

q5_deployment_baselines.answer: DEPENDENCY_RULE remains strongest: utility 9.4961, success 1.0, wrong 0, queries 0.5039, process_support/final_correct 1.0, 0 model calls. QUERY_ONCE utility 9.0. BASE_POINTER utility -15.49, success 0.363, wrong 0.637. No trained arm beats the rule or query-only.

q6_claim_and_expansion.answer: Do not claim a process-reward win or a new PRM. Do not auto-expand the matrix. The G7 result is a negative training result: the process verifier is correct, but under this pointer/group protocol PROCESS does not beat OUTCOME and both collapse to query-only; process SFT learns labels but not safe terminal utility on composition.

implementation_notes.rl_initialization: seeded Gaussian LoRA-B std=0.7 (same for PROCESS/OUTCOME at a seed); zero LoRA-B leaves a near-deterministic base and many all-same four-rollout groups
implementation_notes.rl_kl_reference: frozen initial adapter policy (not base) with KL coefficient 0.02; needed because the nonzero init is part of the initial policy
implementation_notes.sft_initialization: standard zero LoRA-B; earlier random-init SFT attempts were stopped and removed, not included
implementation_notes.sampling: categorical temperature 1.0 over allowed label tokens A..J/Z; argmax only at evaluation
implementation_notes.test_usage: test used only for final evaluation; dev at 32/64/128 updates; no test-based selection
implementation_notes.hidden_values: no hidden U world values in prompts/training labels/final predictions; query_value fields were removed from all predictions
implementation_notes.g6: G6 GPU inference not rerun; strict metrics recomputed CPU-only from frozen cases/predictions
